result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the fundamental human condition of scarcity—not just material scarcity, but the scarcity of empathy, time, and understanding. 

Strip away the constant, gnawing fear of "not enough"—not enough food, not enough safety, not enough love, not enough time—and you remove the root cause of almost every cruelty, conflict, and injustice. 

If people inherently knew they were secure, and that others were too, the instinct to hoard, dominate, and destroy would wither. We would finally have the breathing room to be genuinely curious about one another instead of defensive.
